basis: The completed 526-taxon registry contains 60,917,860 feature rows, 5,983,922 gene rows, 5,815,847 representatives and 64,512,704,512 bytes of SQLite inputs. The receipt-level census bounds a 512-byte-per-row gene-order table at 2,977,713,664 bytes and a 384-byte-per-row immediate-neighbor table at 4,466,570,496 bytes. This exporter streams one read-only SQLite registry at a time and writes one gzip table per taxon; 32 GiB allows source-product JSON, compression, receipts and conservative temporary overhead. The 1-48 h range is an uncalibrated planning range, not an ETA.
scope: Full immutable source-coordinate export across all 526 manifest taxa. It preserves native gene ordering and records the two ORF-coordinate taxa as provisional rather than gene order. It does not infer assemblies, repeats, orthology, synteny, duplication, rearrangements or structural evolution.
